info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Institution Oauth Url-spec
info.description: The Institution OAuth URL Generation API enables businesses to create OAuth URLs specific to a given institution. This functionality is essential for securely authenticating users within external applications that require institutional access. By providing the institution ID, developers can generate unique OAuth URLs, streamlining the integration process for third-party applications. This API serves financial institutions, application developers, and service providers looking to enhance user authentication and access management.

post.summary: Create a new OAuth URL for the specified institution.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to generate a new OAuth URL for the institution identified by RES-100045. By providing the necessary data in the request body, you can create an OAuth URL that clients can use to authenticate with the institution's services.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update the OAuth URLs for a specific institution identified by RES-100045. It accepts a JSON object that contains the necessary details for the OAuth configuration.

201.description: Resource successfully created and OAuth URLs generated.
